def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Count sends accepted by a channel of capacity cap before it is full."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0
    post out <= cap
    post out <= xs.len()
    ch = Channel[int](cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        if not ch.try_send(x):
            break
        n += 1
    return n
